rights.licence: Copernicus Sentinel Data legal notice (Regulation (EU) No 1159/2013)

provenance.notes: Quotas page (2026-11-10), Copernicus General Users, column "S3, OData, STAC": no monthly request quota; 2000 requests/minute applies only to S3 (footnote 14), so no published request rate for STAC search; 4 concurrent connections and 20 MB/s per connection for Immediately Available Data (dropping to 1 connection and 1 MB/s after the 12 TB monthly transfer), stated per account: whether anonymous STAC searches count toward it is not said (concurrency 4 declared as the column's figure). Terms: fair use, no multiple accounts to exceed quotas. Sentinel data: free, full and open; the legal notice permits reproduction, distribution, communication to the public, adaptation; notice 'Copernicus Sentinel data [Year]' (or 'Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [Year]' when modified) required on distribution. Other collections carry their own licence (each collection's license link). The portal's own content is non-commercial, not the Sentinel data. Contact: help center 'Submit a request' (no API address published). No rate-limit headers seen on a test call.
